prohibited_inferences: Do not treat floor v49 or PC-51 as evidence that any named person organization institution platform network source system artifact or deployment reviewed built signed reproduced or executed specific bytes.
Do not infer complete review scope from a repository URL branch tag commit label partial diff or selected file list.
Do not infer that reviewed source produced the build when submodules vendored sources generated inputs patches or build scripts remain unbound.
Do not infer a reproducible build from one recipe or one successful build without exact graph toolchain flags environment timestamps generated inputs and byte comparison.
Do not infer independent reproduction from a second build without attributed independence clean-room state complete attempts logs and divergence disposition.
Do not infer package executable entry-point or generated-resource identity from one artifact digest.
Do not infer complete provenance from one signature without signer key delegation scope subjects materials predicate transparency expiry and revocation custody.
Do not infer current signature validity from one historical transparency receipt after expiry revocation key succession or statement withdrawal.
Do not infer source-to-output execution identity from one provenance statement startup command or successful replay.
Do not treat the absence of an attestation failure record as evidence that no source build reproduction signature package entry-point invocation output or correction drift occurred.
Do not infer current assurance after source recipe toolchain builder signer key artifact package entry-point release correction or use succession.
Do not infer public authorization from complete review build reproduction provenance or execution-attestation custody.
Do not infer coercion manipulation discrimination breach misconduct coordination common purpose intent or security compromise from review build provenance or attestation failure.

Do not treat synthetic review build provenance or attestation burdens as real-world defect prevalence security compromise rates causal effects welfare trajectories or institutional-performance estimates.
Do not collapse a valid signature into a claim that the signed subject is the invoked package entry point or executed bytes.
Do not collapse matching output metrics into byte identity source identity or complete execution-attestation custody.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A compositional successor floor preserving the qualified fifty-control v48 base and adding PC-51 review-scope, reproducible-build, independent-reproduction, artifact-signature, provenance, transparency, revocation, package, entry-point, execution-attestation, correction, and current-lineage equifinality.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real source-code review, reproducible-build audit, independent reproduction, artifact signature or provenance verification, transparency-log validation, execution attestation, security finding, interval-validity finding, causal effect, longitudinal history, graph fact, allegation, or public-authority verdict.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Preference Custody floor v49 composes the qualified v48 controls with PC-51. It separates complete-looking source-review, reproducible-build, provenance, and execution-attestation badges from complete review scope, exact independently reproduced bytes, current unrevoked signature and provenance scope, package and entry-point identity, source-to-output attestation, correction, and current succession.
